shortDescription: Create and manage Koji external repos

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Koji external repo to create and manage.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL to the Koji external repo. Note, this uses "$arch", not the common "$basearch" you may find in a typical Yum repository file. For idempotency, please ensure your url always ends with a "/" character. If you leave it out, Koji Hub will automatically add a "/" slash when storing this value in the database, and every subsequent Ansible run will appear to be "changing" the external repo's URL.
